entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-06-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • dotnet watch crashes with 'Index was outside the bounds of the array' #49448
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/8.0.1xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #49440
  • [NetTestingE2E][Regression] Error "The library hostfxr.dll was found..." will throw when executing "dotnet test --arch x86 --diag:log1.txt". #49436
  • running a standalone C# file with dependencies on other .cs files. #49435

Closed

  • [macOS] dotnet publish cannot write pkg file #24348
  • dotnet run --property:Configuration=Release creates release binaries on linux, but tries to execute debug version which is not there #24277
  • dotnet-sdk-9.0.100-rc.2.24474.11-win-x64.exe -> This App can't be run on your PC -> Microsoft Windows 11 Enterprise Insider Preview #43984
  • Building PublishProfile=DefaultContainer doesn't show output indicating a container image gets built. [.NET 9] #44837
  • .NET 10 drops supports Windows 10 and macOS Ventura #46678
  • Suggestion: Align .Net and C# versions #49455
  • dotnet NativeAOT build as StaticLib does not work #49413
  • Please add support to load other files #49414
  • [Feature] Proposing an option to include other C# source files for `dotnet run app.cs` #49193
    11.0.1xx
  • Make `dotnet run file.cs` compiled program location user-configurable #49130
